description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 15.12.2025 to 21.12.2025
reasoning: The gazette content is a Customs notification issued under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It formally determines and publishes new statutory rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. This falls squarely under the definition of a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5), as it involves the exercise of regulatory power, amends a previous legal notice, and establishes a compliance requirement (the new exchange rates) under existing legislation.
